opening.argument: The video is a straightforward dance performance, with two people performing in front of the GM Dance Centre sign and the title identifying it as “New Dance Shorts on Care Ni Karda.” Its accompanying links fit ordinary creator and dance-class promotion: the description provides a class link and contact email, but does not state that classes or access to guidance are paid. The request for feedback about more Shorts is audience engagement, not a condition for receiving a benefit. The accompanying speech is song-like lyrical material, including “you don't care about us don't spare time i am behind you,” and supplies no separate solicitation mechanism. Taken together, the performance and promotional details do not establish a deceptive offer or required payment.
